Title: Disloyal Man, Disobedient Heaven
Source Situation / Theme: After Shawn's motorcycle crash, Tara defies instructions and takes him to a hospital; she improves her ACT score and is admitted to BYU.
Design Extraction: A practical emergency can become the moment a player discovers they are capable of disobedience.
Game Transformation: Build a timed transport decision with an explicit safe route and a socially costly home route, followed by an application result.
Guardrail: The game never punishes the player for choosing emergency care.

Title: To Keep It Holy
Source Situation / Theme: Tara arrives at BYU and experiences intense culture shock in housing, classes, religion, and ordinary social life.
Design Extraction: A larger world is not automatically comfortable. Familiar rules may become a refuge even when they once confined the player.
Game Transformation: Introduce the College City as a dense hub where the player must learn schedules, social norms, systems, and navigation without losing agency.
Guardrail: Outside institutions must have limits and blind spots; they are not a perfect world.

Title: Blood and Feathers
Source Situation / Theme: Money, hygiene, and academic expectations threaten Tara's place at college until she learns the hidden rules of studying and her grades rise.
Design Extraction: The 'hidden curriculum' can make a capable person feel unintelligent. Learning how a system works is itself a form of education.
Game Transformation: Make study mechanics about planning, reading, asking, and revising rather than reflex tests; pair them with a real budget.
Guardrail: Do not turn poverty or social ignorance into ridicule.

Title: In the Beginning
Source Situation / Theme: Tara returns home for summer, is forced back into scrapping, receives a scholarship, and begins a relationship with Charles.
Design Extraction: Returning home after growth makes old conditions newly visible, while new opportunities remain fragile.
Game Transformation: Reopen the starting region with advanced player skills that the family interprets as pride, usefulness, or betrayal.
Guardrail: Do not make the scholarship a magic escape; material and relational costs remain.

Title: Recitals of the Fathers
Source Situation / Theme: Education changes how Tara understands a racial slur and the behavior of her father and brother; Charles provides another social reference point.
Design Extraction: New knowledge can transform the meaning of familiar language and reveal harm that was previously normalized.
Game Transformation: Unlock context-sensitive dialogue only after the player has learned relevant history; allow public, private, and delayed responses.
Guardrail: Never require the player to repeat slurs; describe harmful language without reproducing it.

Title: Skullcap
Source Situation / Theme: A simple dose of ibuprofen relieves Tara's ear pain and becomes evidence that her family's rejected methods may be useful.
Design Extraction: A small ordinary experience can crack a total worldview more powerfully than an argument.
Game Transformation: Let treatment options produce observable outcomes recorded in the memory journal without an omniscient 'correct' label.
Guardrail: Do not frame herbs as fake or conventional care as infallible; compare specific evidence.
